links.comparator_used: AI-assisted diagnosis visit with no clinician present (AI acting alone)
links.outcome: Patient choice of a hypothetical AI-assisted diagnostic visit (the study also measured trust ratings)
links.effect: Clinician presence increased the probability of selecting a visit by 18.4% (95% CI, 17.3%-19.5%; P < .00025)
links.quote: The presence of a clinician was associated with increasing the probability of selecting a visit by 18.4% (95% CI, 17.3%-19.5%; P < .00025).

design_hint: governance certification, human-in-the-loop clinician oversight, and data disclosure
